name: Phase 3.1 — Folio & Checkout Foundation
body:
## Phase 3.1 — Folio & Checkout Foundation

Covers Phase 3.1 through Phase 3.1B2, establishing the complete folio ledger, payment layer, checkout integration, and Folio/Checkout UI.

### Included phases

- **Phase 3.1** — Payment Foundation (deposits, payments, refunds, adjustments)
- **Phase 3.2** — Folio Foundation (folio lifecycle, entry posting, void)
- **Phase 3.1A** — Folio Charge Ledger Backend (FolioService, FolioEntryPolicy, audit trail)
- **Phase 3.1B1** — Checkout Integration (ADR-38 through ADR-49: stay lifecycle, OutstandingBalanceException, partial checkout, terminal guard)
- **Phase 3.1B2** — Folio UI & Checkout UI (ADR-50 through ADR-54: Vue component extraction, flash routing fixes, system entry guard, paymentSummary as canonical source)

### Key invariants enforced

- ADR-50: System entry void is a business invariant in FolioService, never in policy
- ADR-51: paymentSummary is the single canonical financial source
- ADR-52: Checkout disabled state is UX only; OutstandingBalanceException is authoritative
- ADR-53: OutstandingBalanceException caught per-controller, redirects to tab=payments
- ADR-54: can_reopen computed once in controller including terminal check

### Test baseline

303 tests passing, 25 pre-existing room-board failures (unrelated to this phase).
